messages:
lucy (People Ops): Follow-up from today's All-Hands: collecting answers about travel reimbursements, desk hoteling limits, offsite childcare, and etiquette for mixed-presence sprints. I'll update the FAQ after this thread.

tess (Eng): For travel receipts: can I upload a screenshot of an Uber ride or does it need the full receipt? Also what about tipping?

rafa (Finance): Screenshots are OK as long as they show date, amount, and vendor. Tip is reimbursable up to 20% of fare; include line item if possible. Use expense category "Travel: Ground".

omar (Facilities): Desk hoteling update: bookings open 6 days ahead, max 3 reserved days per person in any 14-day window. We keep ~10% of desks for same-day drop-ins. Team blocks require a 7-business-day lead and are limited to 8 desks without exec sign-off. Booking tool: https://redwood.booking.internal

ben (CEO): Offsites: Product offsite aiming for Aug 8-9 (tentative). Company all-hands offsite still planned for Q4. Managers please avoid scheduling major launches those weeks.

lucy (People Ops): Childcare stipend pilot: $175 per family for company-funded offsites (requires invoice/receipt). Pilot applies to the Aug product offsite; confirm with manager before booking.

tess (Eng): Any shuttle/subsidy for airport transfers for the offsite? Flying in from outside the region.

omar (Facilities): We're evaluating a shuttle from the main airport + negotiated hotel rates. Final logistics will be posted to the offsite doc once approved.

ops-bot: Note: provisional calendar event "Product Offsite (Tentative)" Aug 8-9 created. RSVP optional.

lucy (People Ops): Hybrid etiquette: teams should publish a sprint's in-person days 72 hours in advance on team channel and mark on the collab calendar. For cross-team workshops, aim for 2 weeks notice.

rafa (Finance): Expense tip: put project code on every submission to speed reimbursement. Reimbursements processed within 5 business days.

lucy (People Ops): Action items: update People Ops FAQ with these specifics and links to booking & pre-approval forms. DM me for exceptions. Thanks! :thumbsup:
